Matt scaled engineering teams from a small pilot to a 150+ person organization at **Accenture**'s Cloud Innovation Centers. The result was a 150+ person organization with near-zero attrition in the first two years. The hiring and evaluation systems maintained integrity through continuous scaling, allowing teams to deliver high-quality work without adding unnecessary management layers. This approach not only scaled the team but also ensured that they were capable of executing at a high standard independently.
